fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. 1. Applicants who are under 18 years old by September 1, 2025, must submit a Guarantee Statement, The guarantor should be an adult, living in Chinese mainlandwith a stable source of income. You can download a template or sample from here . 2. Proof Documents Emigrants from Chinese mainland, Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan applying as international students must have obtained their current foreign citizenship before April 30, 2021. In addition, the applicant must have lived outside China for at least 2 years during the period between April 30, 2021 and April 30, 2025. Please provide the following documents: (1) copies of all passports he/she used to have (2) all copies of visa or residence permit relevant to stay in Chinese mainland, Hong Kong, Macau or Taiwan. * 3. Statement of non-criminal record * 4. Two letters of recommendation in Chinese or English from whom can attest to the quality of the applicant’sacademic performance and scholastic potential. The letters must include recommenders’ phone number and email address.If the letters cannot be uploaded by the applicant, the applicant can send the link in the system to the recommender for filling in the letter. * 5. Statement of personal financial capacity or financial support You can download a template or sample from here . 6. Applicants currently residing in China must providea copy of the page containing a valid visa or residence permit. 7. Other materials Applicants may send additional documents which may demonstrate their comprehensive abilities along with the required documents, for example, award certificates, published essays, admission notices from other universities, etc. Please scan or synthesize them in a single PDF or Word file. * 8. Certificate of HSK Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) * 9. Photocopy of valid passport identification page. Only ordinary passportis accepted and the expiry date should be later than September 30, 2025. * 10. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant * 11. Diploma of highest degree conferred or proof of impending graduation (for applicants in their final year of study) Original or notarized copy, with notarized Chinese or English translation, if original not in Chinese or English. * 12. Transcripts of highest degree conferred Original or notarized copy, with notarized Chinese or English translation, if original not in Chinese or English. * 13. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Basic Eligibility: (1)Non-Chinese citizens holding foreign passports. (2)High school graduate or above, with eligibility for university application. (3)Physically and mentally healthy, with no criminal record. 2. Nationality Eligibility *This only applies to applicants who were born to parent(s)with Chinesecitizenship at the time of birth. According to the < Nationality Law of the People's Republic of China > and the relevant provisions issued by the Ministry of Education of China:(1)For applicants who were born in a foreign country and have acquired foreigncitizenship at birth, The applicants’parent (Chinese-citizen side) must have had obtained foreign permanent residency before the applicants’birth. In addition, the applicant must have a record of actual residence abroad(outside Chinesemainland/long Kong/Macao/Taiwan) for at least 2 years between May 1, 2022, and April 30, 2026 (calculated in cycles from May 1 to April 30 of the following year, 9 months of actual residence per cycle counts as one year, verified by entry/exit stamps). (2)For applicants who have emigrated from China and have acquired foreign citizenship. The applicants must have obtained foreign nationality before May 1, 2022. and completed formalities for renouncing the Chinese citizenship. In addition, the applicants must have a record of actual residence abroad(outside Chinese mainland/ong Kong/Macao/Taiwan) for at least 2 years between May 1, 2022, and April 30, 2026 (calculated in cycles from May 1 to April 30 of the following year, 9 months of actual residence per cycle counts as one year, verified by entry/exit stamps). 3. Language certificate and score report (HSK). Level 5 (score 210 or above) orLevel 6 (score 180 or above). This is NOT mandatory. 4. Required Subjects for the CSCA Test, download here . Note: (1) The program is designed for international students only; (2) Change of major is not allowed.
